subject: Recap: Today’s demo + proposed trial success pathway for Archipelago
messages:
From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Iyer <sanjay@archipelago.com>, Priya Menon <priya.m@archipelago.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T14:05:00-07:00
Subject: Recap: Today’s demo + proposed trial success pathway for Archipelago

Hi Sanjay / Priya —

Thanks again for taking time today — great conversation and very helpful context on your catalog ingestion needs and edge-case moderation constraints. Below is a short recap and a concrete 4-week trial proposal so your team can validate fit quickly.

Quick demo recap:
- Ingestion: you showed examples of multi-format product specs (CSV + nested JSON). We confirmed we'd use Redwood’s streaming ingest with schema mapping to reduce tokenization overhead.
- Latency constraints: target 300–400ms p95 for median query workloads.
- Security: Must run in a VPC with customer-managed KMS; redaction controls required for PII.

Proposed 4-week trial (concise):
1) Goals / success criteria (what we’ll measure):
   - Functional: 90%+ accuracy on API-generated product summaries vs. your human baseline (sample set of 600 records).
   - Performance: p95 latency <= 450ms for the primary query route; sustain 10 qps with 250 token avg.
   - Cost target: projected token cost < $0.012 per query in our simulated workload (we’ll provide batch/quantization settings).
   - Safety/regulatory: evidence of consistent redaction on sample PII cases (zero PII leaks in test set).
2) Scope: ingest ~5k product rows (CSV + metadata), run 3 canonical prompt families (summary, attribute extraction, categorization).
3) Owners & roles:
   - Archipelago: Sanjay (product), Priya (data/ops) — provide sample data and acceptance baseline.
   - Redwood: Olga (engage lead), Ben (trial success / commercial liaison), Laura (CS for onboarding + runbook).
4) Timeline (high level):
   - Week 0 (this week): Data handoff + access (SFTP or GCS link), security checklist signoff.
   - Week 1: Ingest + baseline run (we’ll share initial metrics).
   - Week 2: Tune prompts/quantization, run full evaluation set.
   - Week 3: Stabilize + quality review with your SMEs.
   - Week 4: Acceptance window and decision meeting.
5) Deliverables: ingestion pipeline, evaluation report (accuracy + latency + cost), runbook for production on Redwood Private.

Attachments: I’ve attached an initial POC scope workbook and the Redwood security datasheet. Also included a sample prompt set (sample-eval-prompts.csv) so you can preview expected inputs.

Next steps I propose (please confirm):
- Sanjay/Priya: confirm data share method and target handoff date (can you provide by Friday 16 Oct?).
- Ben/Laura/Olga: set up a 30-min kickoff with your data engineer and security on Monday 19 Oct.

Happy to adjust scope — if any of the success metrics above feel off, tell us and we’ll adapt.

Best,
Olga

--
Olga Petrov | Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
olga.petrov@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Redwood Inference

From: Sanjay Iyer <sanjay@archipelago.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Menon <priya.m@archipelago.com>
Date: 2026-10-11T16:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Today’s demo + proposed trial success pathway for Archipelago

Hi Olga —

Thanks for the clear recap and the detailed plan — this is exactly what we needed. A couple quick clarifications from our side: 

- Data handoff: we can provide a secure GCS bucket. I’ll invite Priya’s team to the bucket. Targeting EOD Friday 16 Oct for a first export.
- Acceptance metric: for the 90%+ accuracy — is that strict equality on the summary text or a tolerance based on human-annotated NIST-like scoring? We prefer a tolerance (e.g., >=0.9 ROUGE-L/semantic-similarity threshold) rather than exact text match.
- Security checklist: we need a confirmation that the VPC deployment will support our HSM-backed KMS and that audit logs will be retained for 90 days.

Assuming those are ok, let’s go ahead with the timeline. We’re happy to do the kickoff on Mon 19 Oct — Priya, can you confirm your availability?

Sanjay
Senior Product Manager | Archipelago Systems

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-12T08:14:00-07:00
Subject: Internal: Archipelago trial — pricing guardrails and SLA ask

Olga / Laura,

Looping in a quick note for commercial and CS planning before the kickoff:
- Commercial: archipelago wants a short-term evaluation that could convert to Dedicated within 60–90 days. We should be prepared with a provisional pricing outline tied to the projected 10 qps and the cost target Olga listed. I’ll draft a 60-day evaluation quote and run it by finance.
- SLA/Logs: they want 90-day audit log retention and HSM-backed KMS in the VPC. Laura — are those covered by our Private offering defaults or do we need a special add-on?

I’ve penciled in the Mon 19 Oct 10:00am PT kickoff (hold on calendar). Olga — can you lead the tech agenda and invite our infra eng?

Thanks,
Ben
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

From: Olga Petrov <olga.petrov@redwood.com>
To: Sanjay Iyer <sanjay@archipelago.com>, Priya Menon <priya.m@archipelago.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-14T09:32:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Recap: Today’s demo + proposed trial success pathway for Archipelago

Thanks Sanjay — exactly the right questions. Quick answers and a small update before the kickoff: 

> On 2026-10-11 Sanjay Iyer wrote:
> - Data handoff: we can provide a secure GCS bucket.
> - Acceptance metric: prefer tolerance based on semantic similarity.
> - Security: confirm HSM-backed KMS + 90-day audit retention.

1) Data handoff — GCS works fine. Please share a read-only service account with path and we’ll begin ingest Thursday 15 Oct.
2) Evaluation metrics — agreed: we’ll use a combined metric: ROUGE-L >= 0.9 OR semantic-similarity >= 0.88 (embedding cosine) on the summary set. We’ll include a per-prompt confusion matrix so you can see where edge cases fail.
3) Security — confirmed: Redwood Private supports customer-managed KMS (HSM) and we will enable 90-day audit log retention for the trial environment. I’ve attached the security datasheet (redwood-security-datasheet.pdf) with exact controls.

Kickoff agenda (30 min) — Mon 19 Oct 10:00am PT
- 5m intros + roles
- 10m data handoff & access (Sanjay / Priya + OLGA)
- 10m ingest plan / evaluation inputs (Laura + eng)
- 5m next steps / acceptance criteria and timeline (Ben)

Pre-kickoff asks (small):
- Sanjay/Priya: please upload a sample of 300 records (a representative mix) by Fri 16 Oct and confirm the service account.
- Laura: can you prepare a 1-page runbook snippet we will use for the evaluation (ingest commands + rollbacks)?
- Ben: please send the provisional evaluation quote draft by Monday so procurement has something to review.

If that all looks good I’ll send the calendar invite and share the Drive folder with the POC workbook. Looking forward to getting started.

Cheers,
Olga
